desc: Read input, build graph, and identify cycle nodes using Kahn's algorithm.
Build reverse adjacency (children list) for tree DP.
Implement recursive DFS to compute `f_u(v)` for any node, considering only non-cycle children.
For each cycle node, compute the DP of its attached tree (excluding cycle children) as a function of the chosen value v.
For each cycle, compute the product of tree DPs over the cycle and sum over possible common values v=1..M to get the number of valid assignments for that component.
Multiply (since components are independent) the counts of all cycle components modulo 998244353, handling components that are just single nodes (no cycle) appropriately.
Accumulate the answer modulo 998244353 and output.
Test solution on provided sample inputs to verify correctness.
